provisional_working_extent_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(provisional SITE_BOUNDARY, EPSG:4548); internal consistency only, not official site area
provisional_working_extent_area_sqm.interpretation_limit: Not an official, statutory, surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

site_area_sqm.formula: compatibility alias of provisional_working_extent_area_sqm for the repository visual-review contract
site_area_sqm.interpretation_limit: The legacy identifier does not mean official site area; it is not statutory, surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: sum(verified existing and proposed building footprints, EPSG:4548)
building_footprint_area_sqm.reason: 没有同一时点测绘、用途、权属、结构和消防资料；v1概念footprint已删除。

conceptual_blue_green_network_envelope_r.formula: conceptual audit-and-crosslink envelope area / provisional working extent; not statutory green-space ratio
conceptual_blue_green_network_envelope_r.interpretation_limit: Not a statutory green-space ratio or a surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

green_ratio.formula: compatibility alias of conceptual_blue_green_network_envelope_ratio for the repository visual-review contract
green_ratio.interpretation_limit: The legacy identifier is not a statutory green-space ratio or a surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

conceptual_action_envelope_ratio.formula: three diagrammatic flagship action envelopes / provisional working extent; not built public-space ratio
conceptual_action_envelope_ratio.interpretation_limit: Not a statutory public-space ratio or a surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

public_space_ratio.formula: compatibility alias of conceptual_action_envelope_ratio for the repository visual-review contract
public_space_ratio.interpretation_limit: The legacy identifier is not a statutory public-space ratio or a surveyed, built, open, or construction quantity.

conceptual_audit_alignment_length_m.formula: sum only original ROAD-V2-001..004 conceptual alignments in EPSG:4548; embedded audit/section helpers have metric_inclusion=false
conceptual_audit_alignment_length_m.interpretation_limit: Not an official alignment length or a surveyed, built, open, accessible, or construction quantity.

scenario_contract_count.interpretation_limit: Counts submitted contracts only; does not establish field approval or performance.

dual_independent_gate_coverage_ratio.formula: contracts with both independent fabric-maturity and thread-admission gates / submitted contracts
dual_independent_gate_coverage_ratio.interpretation_limit: Submission protocol coverage only; does not establish site readiness, admission, approval or field performance.

human_review_contract_coverage_ratio.display_name_zh: 人工最终复核契约覆盖率
human_review_contract_coverage_ratio.formula: contracts requiring human review / submitted contracts
human_review_contract_coverage_ratio.interpretation_limit: Contract-field coverage only; it does not prove that a qualified reviewer has been appointed or a field review completed.

ordinary_service_equivalence_coverage_ra.display_name_zh: 普通服务等价契约覆盖率
ordinary_service_equivalence_coverage_ra.formula: contracts requiring an ordinary non-AI service route / submitted contracts
ordinary_service_equivalence_coverage_ra.interpretation_limit: Contract-field coverage only; service equivalence remains subject to baseline and affected-user verification.

exit_restoration_receipt_coverage_ratio.display_name_zh: 退出恢复回执契约覆盖率
exit_restoration_receipt_coverage_ratio.formula: contracts with a defined restoration receipt / submitted contracts
exit_restoration_receipt_coverage_ratio.interpretation_limit: Contract-field coverage only; no real exit or restoration has been executed.

implementation_register_count.display_name_zh: 全生命周期项目台账数量
implementation_register_count.interpretation_limit: Counts proposed registers, not established projects, appointed entities or secured budgets.

stage_gate_count.interpretation_limit: Counts proposed gate definitions; no project is represented as having passed a real gate.

verification_handoff_item_count.display_name_zh: 证据核查与责任接续任务数量
verification_handoff_item_count.interpretation_limit: Counts participant-defined verification tasks; all named pending field, rightsholder or authority work remains incomplete.

cost_evidence_item_count.display_name_zh: 全生命周期成本取证条目数量
cost_evidence_item_count.interpretation_limit: Counts unpriced evidence categories; it is not a quotation, approved budget, funding source or procurement result.

operational_prototype_count.display_name_zh: 实施准备度概念原型规格数量
operational_prototype_count.formula: count(S01, S06, S11 operationally specified conceptual prototype records)
operational_prototype_count.interpretation_limit: Counts conceptual prototype specifications, not operational, approved, procured, or deployed services.

design_component_count.interpretation_limit: Diagrammatic L5 anchors; not buildings, approved sites or construction quantities.

audit_segment_count.interpretation_limit: Survey work units only; does not establish built, open or accessible status.

synthetic_contract_case_count.interpretation_limit: Logic regression only; not field performance, technical safety or legal compliance.

floor_area_ratio.formula: approved total floor area / official parcel area
floor_area_ratio.reason: 完整控规图纸、official parcels和建筑普查未公开；蓝景丽家局部指标不得外推。

building_height_m.reason: 只找到局部实施单元高度讨论，不能形成全域控制。

continuous_open_greenway_length_m.reason: 二期配套完工不等于9公里全线连续开放，须逐段现场审计。

verified_step_free_length_m.formula: sum(field-verified continuously open step-free segments, EPSG:4548)
verified_step_free_length_m.reason: 分段已建立但未完成现场坡度、净宽、围挡、过街和开放状态调查。

accessible_crossing_ratio.formula: field-verified accessible crossings / audited crossing candidates
accessible_crossing_ratio.reason: 尚未取得正式过街点、信号、等待时间、缘石坡道和现场无障碍调查。

building_inventory_coverage_ratio.formula: buildings with verified survey, rights, structure, fire and heritage records / buildings in official scope
building_inventory_coverage_ratio.reason: 正式范围和逐栋调查均未取得，不能形成分母或拆改留准备度。

project_readiness_by_gate.formula: highest jointly passed weave-readiness, thread-admission and G0-G6 stage gate
project_readiness_by_gate.reason: 责任主体、场地、资金、采购和专业核验尚未依法确定；当前仅完成投稿协议结构。
